action_items.detail: The QA project 'QA Photo Retest' (code QAPR) was created through the API for the photos journey. Its id is b04e10ac-eb06-4aba-a737-2d5cc448d6d1 and it now has 8 test photos. It shows up in the Home 'All projects' filter and in the report project filters, so purge it when you're done. The project 'Ye' was not touched.

Shalini Thakur's card status (customers list, 'all' view) is 'DUE TODAY', but her customer page and booking say 'Overdue since 05 Apr 2026'. EliteCustomerCard returns 'Due today' when state is 'due' and next is not a dated bill, because other-charges overdue is not counted in overdue_paise. The status is inside the allowed set, but it disagrees with Next due.

EliteCustomerCard.jsx has an 'All clear' fallback that is outside the allowed status set (OVERDUE/DUE TODAY/DUE ON/ADVANCE HELD/NEXT). The 'all clear' segment holds 1 customer. The status-set check only scanned the default needs-attention list (12 cards, all OVERDUE N DAYS). The member-card check saw DUE ON / DUE TODAY / OVERDUE across all 80.
Outstanding hub caption 'outstanding till today · ₹5.98 Cr overdue' does not end with a period word. Cosmetic.
